rationale: The collector consumed body promises from a reused Page after navigating away from lazy-loaded Portal responses. The browser error explicitly identifies response-body unavailability after navigation; it does not identify a bad HTTP status or content mismatch. The first per-page Promise.all snapshot still failed because late response registration can escape the captured array entries. Current helper now creates three distinct live Pages, retains their documents, waits for page network idle and dynamically drains newly registered promises before disposing pages. This removes the inspected resource-lifetime problem. The actual root targeted report verifies 37HTTP200 exact byte hashes and zero pageerrors on unchanged game runtime, supporting test-infrastructure rather than product-delivery diagnosis.

final_root_cause: A test collector allowed navigation to discard CDP response resources before asynchronous/lazily registered body reads completed. Keeping each route in its own live Page and draining dynamically before disposal resolved the collector failure in the targeted actual run.
